newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Aug economic growth over 9.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Aug economic growth over 9.0 pct.

text.p: China's economic growth was estimated at more than 9.0 percent for the first eight months of this year, central bank governor Dai Xianglong told an economic forum on Tuesday.
China's economy grew by 9.8 percent in the first half of the year, official figures have shown.
China reported gross domestic product growth of 10.2 percent in 1995 and had set a target of 8.0-9.0 percent growth for all of 1996.
Dai said he expected growth to hit about 10 percent for the year.
